monetization.noteEs: Single-player puro. Compra única (Special Edition o Anniversary Edition, ~$40 USD). La AE agrega contenido del Creation Club — quests, armaduras, hechizos creados por Bethesda y modders contratados. No hay battle pass, no hay microtransacciones recurrentes. Las Creations individuales se pueden comprar sueltas si tienes solo SE, pero la mayoría de la comunidad mods gratis cubre y supera ese contenido.
monetization.noteEn: Pure single-player. One-time purchase (Special Edition or Anniversary Edition, ~$40 USD). AE adds Creation Club content — quests, armor, spells created by Bethesda and contracted modders. No battle pass, no recurring microtransactions. Individual Creations can be bought standalone with just SE, but most free community mods cover and exceed that content.
